title: Looking for Senior DevOps Engineer (Linux / On-Premises Infrastructure)
description:
Job Title: Senior DevOps Engineer (Linux / On-Premises Infrastructure)
Job type: Full-time
Location: Remote (Operating in the UTC+3 time zone)
Eligibility: Global candidates welcome (Please note: Due to international compliance and payment regulations, we are currently unable to accept applications from candidates based in RF/RB).

About the Role
We are seeking a highly experienced Senior DevOps & Infrastructure Engineer to join our distributed engineering team. Unlike strictly cloud-native roles, this position requires deep, hands-on expertise in Linux administration, on-premises infrastructure, and virtualization technologies. You will be responsible for automating OS deployments, securing environments, and building robust CI/CD pipelines to support our mission-critical enterprise applications.

Key Responsibilities
Infrastructure & OS Automation: Architect, deploy, and manage Linux-based infrastructure (specifically Rocky Linux / Red Hat). Automate OS installations and provisioning using Kickstart.
Packaging & Deployment: Take full ownership of RPM packaging and deployment processes across our enterprise environments.
CI/CD Pipeline Management: Design, build, and maintain robust Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment pipelines utilizing Jenkins.
Security & Hardening: Enforce strict security protocols, including Linux OS hardening, regular security patching, and secure system configuration.
Virtualization & On-Premises Management: Manage and optimize on-premises infrastructure and virtualization layers using VMware, KVM, Hyper-V, or Nutanix.
Database Operations Support: Oversee PostgreSQL deployments, executing reliable backup, replication, and disaster recovery (restore) procedures.

Requirements
Senior-Level Expertise: 5+ years of proven, senior-level experience in DevOps, Linux System Administration, or Infrastructure Engineering.
Linux Mastery: Deep, practical knowledge of Linux Operating Systems, with a strong preference for Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) or Rocky Linux.
Advanced Scripting: Strong programming and scripting skills for automation using Bash, coupled with Python, Perl, or Ruby.
CI/CD & Automation: Solid, hands-on experience with Jenkins for CI/CD workflows and Kickstart for automated installations.
Virtualization Fluency: Proven track record of managing on-premises infrastructure and hypervisors (VMware, KVM, Nutanix, etc.).
Database Knowledge: Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL administration (specifically backups and restores).
Communication & Availability: Upper-Intermediate (B2+) English proficiency. Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly and collaborate effectively during UTC+3 core working hours.

Nice-to-Have
Experience with containerization and orchestration (Docker / Kubernetes).
Strong understanding of enterprise networking, LDAP, and Active Directory (AD).
